queries: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate / AVG(rate) OVER () AS rate_divided_by_mean FROM media_rates;

WITH rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS rate FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate / NULLIF(AVG(rate) OVER (), 0) AS relative_rate FROM rates;

WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS rate FROM Track AS t INNER JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate / AVG(rate) OVER () AS rate_relative_to_mean FROM media_rates;

responses.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate / AVG(rate) OVER () AS rate_divided_by_mean FROM media_rates;

assumptions.assumption: Each media type is identified by MediaTypeId, even if names repeat. SQL SUM ignores NULL Bytes, and AVG ignores undefined rates.

responses.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS rate FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate / NULLIF(AVG(rate) OVER (), 0) AS relative_rate FROM rates;

assumptions.assumption: NULL Bytes are ignored when summed. A media type with an undefined rate has a NULL rate and is excluded from the mean.

responses.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS rate FROM Track AS t INNER JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate / AVG(rate) OVER () AS rate_relative_to_mean FROM media_rates;

assumptions.assumption: The mean includes media types with matched tracks. SQL SUM ignores NULL Bytes; a zero total duration produces a NULL rate.
